description: This source file defines an admin dashboard screen for a Flutter web application. It manages three tabs displaying users, credentials, and audit logs, fetching data asynchronously from backend API endpoints and handling errors.

classes.name: AdminDashboardScreen
classes.description: A StatefulWidget representing the admin dashboard screen with tabbed views for users, credentials, and audits.

classes.name: _AdminDashboardScreenState
classes.description: The private state class managing data loading, error handling, and UI updates for AdminDashboardScreen.

methods.name: _loadUsers
methods.description: Fetches user data from the '/admin/users' API endpoint and updates the state.

methods.name: _loadCredentials
methods.description: Fetches credentials data from the '/admin/credentials' API endpoint and updates the state.

methods.name: _loadAudits
methods.description: Fetches audit logs from the '/admin/audits' API endpoint and updates the state.
